metadata.case_name: TSUI KWAN FAI v. GOLDFIELD N & W CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

source: The Plaintiff sustained multiple injuries to his face, right upper limb and right shoulder.

injuries.description: closed fracture of the head of the right radius (fractured right radial head)
source: X-ray examination showed that the Plaintiff had a fractured right radial head.
The Plaintiff has a closed fracture of the head of the right radius and sustained soft tissue injury to his right wrist and right shoulder.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of upper end of radius

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to the right wrist
source: The Plaintiff has a closed fracture of the head of the right radius and sustained soft tissue injury to his right wrist and right shoulder.

Medical report dated 12 July 2005 by Dr Poon shows that the Plaintiff was diagnosed to have suffered from closed fracture of the head of the right radius and soft tissue injury to the right wrist and right shoulder.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified muscle, fascia or tendon at wrist or hand level

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to the right shoulder
source: The Plaintiff has a closed fracture of the head of the right radius and sustained soft tissue injury to his right wrist and right shoulder.

Medical report dated 12 July 2005 by Dr Poon shows that the Plaintiff was diagnosed to have suffered from closed fracture of the head of the right radius and soft tissue injury to the right wrist and right shoulder.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of muscle, fascia, tendon or bursa at shoulder or upper arm level

manifestations.description: swelling and pain in his right elbow and right wrist
full right wrist motion despite mild pain over distal radius
progressive pain and stiffness of the right elbow (possible development of post-traumatic arthritis)

treatments_received: treated with plaster immobilization of his right hand
received 9 sessions of treatment up to 25 October 2005

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Subsequent to the accident, the Plaintiff ceased to play basketball (at least once or twice a week) and ceased rock climbing.
